item.title: Investigation underway into fatal shooting involving authorities near Philipsburg
item.description: The Montana Division of Criminal Investigation is investigating a fatal officer-involved shooting on Highway 1 near Philipsburg on Sunday, according to a press release from the Montana AG's Office.

item.title: Super Bowl Sunday brings Patriots, Seahawks fans together in Kalispell
item.description: While Montana might not have its own football team, Super Bowl Sunday remains a massive event with watch parties all throughout the Flathead Valley.

item.title: Montana natives Patrick O'Connell, Rick Dennison plus former Bobcat Ty Okada win Super Bowl
item.description: A trio with ties to the Treasure State — Kalispell natives Patrick O'Connell and Rick Dennison and former Montana State Bobcat Ty Okada — are Super Bowl champions.
